_comment: Edit the Markdown files, then run: node scripts/build-git-github-guide.mjs. gateMode: partial (only parts marked gated) or full (everything except alwaysOpen sections). Changing version locks the gated part again for everyone. Sections with "draft": true are left off the page until they are written. Mission numbers are counted from the visible sections.
